profile.businessType: Retail and wholesales of IT products such as assembled computers (D.I.Y), notebook, computer desktop, and peripheral devices, as well as smartphones and home appliances, through branches and online channels and provide comprehensive after-sales service.
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company and its subsidiary's policies are to distribute a dividend to shareholders of no less than 40% of their respective net profit per separate financial statements (after legal and other reserves). The dividend payout must not have a significant impact on the Company's normal operations. The Company's Board of Directors and its shareholders may adjust the dividend payout depending on financial position, operating results, investment and expansion plans and other considerations as deemed appropriate.
